newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin health "satisfactory" before heart surgery.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin health "satisfactory" before heart surgery.

text.p: Doctors are completely satisfied with Russian President Boris Yeltsin's condition ahead of heart surgery soon, spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Thursday.
Interfax news agency quoted Yastrzhembsky as saying that preparations for the operation were going according to plan. "There is no change to the schedule laid down for the operation," he said.
Doctors have said they expect to operate in the second half of November to improve the blood supply to Yeltsin's heart.
The president, 65, had two heart attacks last year and some doctors say he may have had a third just before the second round of a presidential election last July.
Yastrzhembsky said Russian medical specialists had received some equipment from U.S. heart surgery pioneer Michael DeBakey and might use this during the operation.
Yeltsin met Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma on Thursday in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow.
